style_context: Citizenship, diversity, equity, inclusion, leadership, community

images.description: A diverse group of Scouts (different races, genders, and abilities) sitting in a circle outdoors on grass, having an engaged and friendly conversation with notebooks and pencils, sunlight filtering through trees
A multigenerational family of different ages sharing a meal together around a dining table, smiling and engaged in warm conversation, cozy home setting
Scouts of diverse backgrounds working together on a community service project, planting flowers and shrubs in a community garden, wearing clean Scout uniforms and smiling, sunny day
Two Scouts sitting across from each other at a picnic table with notebooks open, discussing ideas earnestly, a Scout handbook visible on the table, outdoor camp setting
A person standing at a symbolic crossroads with two paths diverging in a forest — one path is easy and flat, the other is steeper but leads upward toward sunlight, representing an ethical choice
A Scout sitting under a large shade tree writing thoughtfully in a journal, looking reflective, with a peaceful natural outdoor setting and backpack beside them
A small group of four Scouts sitting around a campfire at dusk, having a serious and thoughtful group discussion, with earnest and engaged facial expressions
An experienced Scout in uniform warmly shaking hands with a newer, slightly nervous Scout at a troop meeting in a community hall, other Scouts visible in the background smiling
Two Scouts of different racial backgrounds sitting on a park bench outdoors, having a friendly one-on-one conversation, both appearing open and relaxed, trees and a walking path in the background
A Scout sitting across from a community leader in a community center or office, holding a notebook and pen, conducting an interview, both leaning in with engaged body language
A group of diverse people standing together in celebration, holding signs of unity and progress, with an American flag visible, representing a moment of positive social change, warm sunlight

Two young people sitting face-to-face in chairs, one speaking with animated hand gestures and the other listening attentively with engaged body language, eye contact, classroom or meeting room setting

A diverse group of young people each engaged in activities that defy common stereotypes — a girl building a robot, a boy cooking, a teenager in a wheelchair playing basketball, a young person reading poetry — vibrant and energetic scene
A Scout standing at a large whiteboard or poster paper, writing out a personal action plan with categories like School, Community, and Scouting visible, markers in hand, determined expression
